{{Quote|Amy, guess what? Daddy's flying a ship called the Stardream. A passenger even gave me a stuffed orokeet, just for you! Tell mom to get a cage&mdash;I'll see you in a few days.|One of Magnus's last communications to his daughter|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Amy''' was the [[Youngling/Legends|child]] of [[Yllen]] and [[Magnus (Galactic War)|Magnus]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the passenger liner ''[[Stardream]]'' during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. On one of the ''Stardream''{{'s}} runs<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_updates|1.1}}</ref> Magnus was given a stuffed [[bird]] known as an [[Orobird/Legends|orokeet]] by a passenger, and he sent a message to his child about the present. However, the ''Stardream'' was quickly overwhelmed by the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], and Magnus's last communication to his daughter before succumbing completely to the plague was a paranoid message about how the crew was trying to take the ship from him.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amy was mentioned in a Codex entry from the Rakghoul Pandemic World Event,<ref name="Codex" /> which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1 in [[2012]].<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.1.0/rise-rakghouls|text=Game Update 1.1: Rise of the Rakghouls Patch Notes}}</ref>
